title: Resuming a compiled subgraph re-runs a node that already completed in the interrupted or failed super-step
observed_behavior: In a flat graph, a completed sibling survives resume of an interrupt/failure in the same super-step (model called once). When the same gate/agent pair is compiled as a subgraph and added as a node, the agent runs again on resume (model called twice) and its answer changes from 'reply 1' to 'reply 2', for both interrupt and failure.
structure_focus: Compiled subgraph as a node; parallel interrupt/failure super-step; pending-write reuse on resume
notes: Open, labels bug/external. Fixture replaces the real chat model with a call counter so the duplicate side effect is visible offline, while keeping the flat-vs-nested and interrupt-vs-failure matrix. Issue compares sync resume paths only; a fix PR (#9306) exists and has independent verification. The bug is framework replay behavior, not graph construction, so the public-API fixture shows the topology but may not fail on every version.
